notes.title: Patch 1.0.6 Notes
notes.content:

notes.title: Full Game is Now Available! + Content Updates
notes.content:
We're proud to announce that the full Mythic Ocean experience is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/814360/Mythic_Ocean/]now available on Steam![/url] Continue the story and make it your own by making choices that shape the universe. Dive deeper into the ocean, meet more gods and charming creatures, and unlock the secrets of the sea.

We've also added some major updates to the Prologue in patch 1.0.5:

[list]
[*] The Prologue features a brand new intro sequence which hints at the nature of the cosmic events taking place in the story.
[*] Elil's dialog at the beginning of the game is slightly modified to better explain the scenario.
[*] You can now view all of the watercolor illustrations you've collected by doing Fables! This is available within the Teleport menu (T on keyboard, X on gamepad). In the full game, your illustration collection will persist across all playthroughs.
[*] You can now read all of the pages you've collected from the Library (also available from the Teleport menu).
[*] The Prologue now supports upgrading your save file to the full game! Please note that you MUST start a fresh save file (and see the new intro) to be able to transfer your save file to the full game and pick up where you left off. Older save files don't support this feature as this would potentially lead to missing new content in the full game.
[*] The settings menu has been redesigned for friendlier gamepad navigation.
[*] Various minor bugfixes
[/list]

We've been blown away by all the support and watching everyone enjoy the Prologue, and can't wait to see everyone's reactions to the full game. Head on over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/814360/Mythic_Ocean/]full game Steam page[/url] to pick it up or wishlist it if you haven't already!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 is live + Discord
notes.content:
Our first patch for Mythic Ocean: Prologue is live! It contains some small quality of life changes and bugfixes.

If you want to chat with us, hang out with other Mythic Ocean: Prologue players, or just share pictures of cute animals, join us on [url=http://discord.mythicoceangame.com]Discord[/url]!

[h1]Patch Notes (Version 1.0.2)[/h1]
[list]
[*] After finishing the demo you can now reload your save file from the main menu to continue playing. This allows you to go back and experience more of the game you might have missed the first time without starting from the beginning.
[*] Fixed a bug where ambient ocean sounds could disappear.
[/list]
